assumptions: The first S input groups are ready and the previous WG is drained before second-output prologue.
One constant producer interval p<=c, issue floor g<=c-q, q+lambda<=c, q>=w+h; all costs nonnegative.
Fixed aggregate ready latency, reuse cost and software paths; no shared background or observer-specific per-iteration change.
prefilled_constant_reuse.scope: Post-treatment same-call necessary condition of the reduced local recurrence; not a proof against the full model family.
limitations: The 46/15 bound is parameter-free within this subclass. No measured initial state or on/off-specific constant is used.
Equal-window slack is the minimum independent +/-epsilon correction to both duration measurements needed to remove the violation. It is not a measured observer error or a confidence bound.
Stage6 also has a small positive residual; known nonuniform measured paths limit exact equality, without identifying the full residual cause.
Constant costs outside the stated branch restrictions can violate this bound. A failure here does not uniquely establish time-varying hardware service.
Only CTA0 second WG is treated; all E0 remains deferred past each CTA own M1. Other-CTA source and output overlap can still change.
S readiness, prior-WG drain and launch phase change jointly. The first-tail timestamp can lag actual drain; its signed relation to wait end is descriptive, not an acceptance gate.
Early=C1-to-C16 and post=C16-to-mma_return use matching same-call cycle/ns endpoints. FIRST-to-C1 has cycles only; no ns or physical DVFS claim is synthesized.
Background is the simple sum of clipped other-131-CTA E0 intervals and the number overlapping; it is not a union, queue size, physical bandwidth or causal attribution.
Primary effects are same-stage on/off paired by trial, which are separate processes. No address/warmup subset or sample is selected for a better result.
Whole progress/plain perturbation does not bound local observer cost. Raw stage4-stage6 differences are not model failure excess; no fitting or validation score is performed.

assumptions: Per-process bounds assume a common fixed nonnegative alpha and Y=alpha+R with R>=0 across all off calls.
These bounds are not conditions imposed on the central fit and are not confidence intervals. R can include waiting, scheduling, recovery or variable observer work.
On spans are comparisons only. They neither set alpha nor split pre-check and post-return costs.
initial_observation_mapping.observation_equation: P is the observed prefill_end; Y=FIRST-P=max(A-P,a_pre)+a_post. The separate pre/post costs and ready time are not observed.
initial_observation_mapping.uniform_tc_offset_equivalence: For E_i=max(B_i+v,E_(i-1))+c, q>=v>=0: Eprime=E-v, qprime=q-v, lambdaprime=lambda+v reproduces all observable events. A prologue-only or variable v is outside this equivalence.

wide_constant_candidates.parameterization: u=ell+a is represented by ready_latency=u, reuse_delay=0; this is a coordinate choice, not a physical zero reuse cost.
wide_constant_candidates.scope: Finite-box off-only development fits; on is a mechanism comparison, not an independent validation.
limitations: No on observations, readiness, entry or E0 times enter either fitting objective or select its result.
Eight coordinates are shared across stages and treatments after removing the exact ell/a translation freedom. c=512 and h=89 are explicit conditional mapping choices.
w<=49 and r<=53 follow the off local windows in the exact mapping; other finite search bounds are numerical choices, not measured hardware limits.
Individual medians need not form one real invocation. Ranges are retained; neither they nor the relative objective define a confidence interval.
Failure of a numerical search is not proof that the wide family is infeasible. Flat or weakly identified parameters are not physical prices.
The modeled prefill begin is consumer availability, not exactly the software prefill timestamp; gate instruction and marker costs are not modeled.
Second mma return and post windows are local endpoints, not complete kernel time. Frequency is not fitted.
